How the numbers are computed.
  • Chain (global) price is read live from the state-dealer catalog (210248).
  • Proposed Bronx local is whatever you type — it never gets written; this page is a scratchpad only.
  • OTD = price × 1.13 (NY combined sales tax).
  • Post-promo subtotal = proposed local × (1 − target discount %). Post-promo OTD = that × 1.13.
  • GM% = 1 − (1.13 × cost) / price — matches reprice.py's convention for this org.
  • Competitor diamonds and market avg/median were refreshed live from the Lit Alerts partner API at gather time (above). Diamonds outside the visible price axis are pulled to the edge at low opacity.
  • Distance bands: near ≤ ~5 mi · mid ≤ ~15 mi · far / very-far / statewide. Only near/mid count as "eligible" for canonical pricing math.

If you settle on a different discount %, applying it Bronx-only is one RPC call: store.promo.action.edit { id: '45102', discountPercent: <new> } at dealer 210249. Per-row local price tweaks go via store.product.edit { id, price } at dealer 210249.
